notes_for_editor: The guide gives a location only (two miles SW of Burpee Mountain) and no dates. The two other sources date a 1930 log cabin patrol lookout, abandoned 1940, but file it under Burpee Mountain, and their reference point (atop Big Creek Point) differs from the guide's. This may be the same structure as us-id-burpee-mountain (status gone, 45.59802, -115.48514); this record sits about 3 km SW of that point. Decide on a merge or keep both by a human. I did not propose a status change because no source says what stands today. The Forest Service PDF (fs.usda.gov/media/259204) was read through fetch_text; its line breaks split some table rows, so the quotes are taken from single lines.
